title: Worst-Day Contributing Signals
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anomalyday:score
| search worst_day=true
| stats sum(contribution_pct) as contribution_pct count as days by signal_name
| sort 0 - contribution_pct
description: Ranks signalss by worst-day contributing signals.
value: A contributing-signal list is the fastest path from a bad day score to a specific hypothesis about why it happened.
implementation: Send worst-day contributing signals events to `index=personal` and keep `signal_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of worst-day contributing signals by signals.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which signalss stand out most for worst-day contributing signals.
